# Fold

> Fold (Fold Notes) is a free, quiet, hardware-grade local-first notes workspace and Progressive Web App (PWA) for the web. Capture thoughts instantly, store them exclusively on-device in IndexedDB, work completely offline, and keep full ownership of your writing with zero tracking, zero cookies, and zero accounts.

## Product Identity

- **Product Name:** Fold (Fold Notes)
- **Tagline:** Notes without the noise
- **Category:** Productivity / Local-First Note-Taking Web Application & PWA
- **Canonical URL:** https://foldnotes.web.app
- **Source Repository:** https://github.com/dhairya0707/fold
- **Creator:** Dhairya Darji (@dhairya0707, https://x.com/dhairya0707)
- **Contact Email:** support.dhairyadarji@gmail.com
- **Pricing:** 100% free forever, no paywalls or subscriptions (MIT License)

## Core Philosophy

- **Local-First:** Your browser is the primary database. Notes are written directly to local disk via IndexedDB with sub-millisecond commits, never queued behind cloud sync spinners or remote APIs.
- **Privacy-First:** Fold collects zero telemetry, bundles zero analytics or error-reporting scripts, sets zero tracking cookies, requires no login or account, and sends zero note data over the network.
- **Digital Minimalism:** No social feeds, no AI chatbots interrupting your draft, and no nested configuration sprawl. Warm paper (`#f4f0e6`) and dark ink (`#141511`) stationery themes designed for sustained calm focus.

## Architecture

- **Primary Database:** IndexedDB database `fold_db` (schema version `2`, object store `notes` keyed by `id` with `updated` and `folder` indexes).
- **Emergency Recovery Mirror & Local Preferences:** Automatic mirror in `localStorage` (`fold.notes.v1`) so edits in flight are never lost on reload or tab close, custom folder list (`fold.folders.v1`), and UI preferences (`fold.theme.v1`, `fold.sound.v1`, `fold.lastBackupDate`), plus automatic migration from legacy `localStorage` notes.
- **Cross-Tab Synchronization:** Real-time `BroadcastChannel` (`fold_sync_v2`) broadcasts `note_saved`, `note_deleted`, and `batch_updated` events across open windows/tabs with zero server round-trips.
- **Zero Network Egress:** Once static assets load, all note creation, editing, full-text search, sorting, locking, pinning, and exporting execute strictly inside the local browser sandbox.
- **Zero Cookies & Zero Accounts:** No session cookies, no authentication tokens, no third-party embeds, and no user registration.
- **Self-Hosted Fonts:** `Instrument Sans` and `JetBrains Mono` are bundled and self-hosted via `next/font/google` at build time, with zero runtime font requests to external CDNs.
- **Offline PWA:** Installable Progressive Web App (`/manifest.webmanifest`) backed by a dedicated Service Worker (`/sw.js`, cache `fold-v2.1`, network-first for navigations and cache-first for static assets) so Fold stays current on deploys while working offline on airplanes, subways, and air-gapped devices.

## Storage, Backup & Portability

- **Markdown Vault (.zip):** One-click ZIP export (`JSZip`) packaging all active notes into folder-organized `.md` files with standard YAML frontmatter (`title`, `date`, `folder`, `tag`, `starred`, `pinned`) plus `fold-vault-manifest.json`, ready for Obsidian, Bear, iA Writer, or any text editor.
- **Full JSON Backup:** Download (`fold-notes-backup-YYYY-MM-DD.json`) and 1-click restore of your entire workspace, including metadata and soft-deleted notes.
- **Single-Note Markdown Export & Copy:** Download any individual note as `<slug>.md` or copy clean CommonMark/GFM Markdown directly to the clipboard.
- **Import Support:** Drag-and-drop or import `.md`, `.txt`, or `.json` vault backups directly into Fold.
- **Eviction Protection:** Built-in Storage & Data Trust modal displays byte usage, `navigator.storage.estimate()`, and one-click `navigator.storage.persist()` browser storage pinning.

## Keyboard Shortcut Reference

Note: On Windows/Linux, replace `⌘` with `Ctrl`.

### Global & Workspace Shortcuts
- `⌘K`: Open Command Palette & Quick Switcher (when text is not selected and caret is not inside a link)
- `/` (outside text inputs/dialogs): Focus the workspace search bar (`Esc` clears and blurs)
- `⌘S`: Flush pending debounced save immediately to IndexedDB and confirm local persistence
- `⌥⇧N` (or `N` outside inputs): Create a new note in the active folder
- `⌘.`: Toggle Full Screen Zen Focus Mode (`Esc` exits)
- `⌘P`: Pin or unpin the selected note
- `⌘D`: Duplicate the selected note
- `⌘\`: Toggle sidebar visibility
- `⌥⇧L`: Lock or unlock the selected note
- `T` (outside inputs): Toggle between warm Paper (`#f4f0e6`) and dark Ink (`#141511`) themes

### Rich-Text Editor Shortcuts
- `⌘B`: Bold
- `⌘I`: Italic
- `⌘K`: Insert or edit hyperlink (inside editor when text is selected or caret is in a link)
- `⌘⌥1` / `⌘⌥2` / `⌘⌥3`: Toggle Heading (`H1` / `H2` / `H3`)
- `⌘⇧8`: Toggle Bullet List
- `⌘⇧7`: Toggle Numbered List
- `⌘⇧9`: Toggle Interactive Task Checklist (`- [ ]` / `- [x]`)
- `⌘⇧Y`: Highlight selected text
- `⌘/`: Show or hide the Floating Bottom Formatting Dock (when a note is active)
- `⌘Z` / `⌘⇧Z`: Undo / Redo
